Title: Pure Pahadi Honey - 300g Glass Jar
Body (HTML):
100% Pure, raw, and unpasteurized mountain honey sourced directly from pristine Himalayan valleys and wildflower blooms.

Harvested ethically from high-altitude mountain bees foraging on wild medicinal flora and seasonal Himalayan blossoms. Our Pure Pahadi Honey is unfiltered, unprocessed, and unheated - retaining all its natural bee pollen, royal jelly traces, therapeutic enzymes, and rich antioxidants.

Key Highlights:

  • 100% Raw & Natural: Zero added sugars, corn syrups, preservatives, or artificial additives.
  • High-Altitude Himalayan Flora: Naturally rich multi-floral profile with deep amber color and distinct floral aroma.
  • Therapeutic & Immunity Boosting: Naturally loaded with enzymes, amino acids, and antibacterial properties.
  • Premium Glass Packaging: Packed in an airtight 300g glass jar to seal in pure mountain freshness.

How to Enjoy:

Enjoy a spoonful daily on an empty stomach with lukewarm water and lemon, drizzle over parathas, toast, or breakfast bowls, or use as a clean natural sweetener in herbal teas.
